en.hubeali:
And from him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Fasts of the three days regarding an expiation for the oath are consecutive, there cannot be a gap in between them’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The fast which is as expiation for an oath must be completed without any interval in between.’”
